Visitor returns rendered heading template as bare string; mixed-case is preserved (regression guard for issue #350)

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorHeadingBareStringPreservesCase struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorHeadingBareStringPreservesCase) VisitHeading(ctx htmd.NodeContext, level uint32, text string, id *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`## %s ##`, text))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorHeadingBareStringPreservesCase{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<h2>Important Section Title</h2><p>Body.</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
